verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says it can 'post a todo list when a new incident is triggered' and route the incident to the right responder, which covers the task-checklist half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows defined incident roles such as commander or comms lead. Escalation policies, on-call schedules and cover requests decide who gets alerted, not who holds which role during the response. Missing for 10: assignable incident roles (commander, comms lead), detail on how checklists are configured and tracked beyond one marketing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
